description: How concentrated Celestia validation and data availability are, from Unity Nodes Pulse: the hosting providers and countries that carry the most validator voting power, how much voting power has no known host, and the public bridge nodes (status, version, uptime, host). Mainnet or the Mocha testnet (bridge nodes are mainnet only). Celestia only, a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes. Host names come from a network crawl and can be wrong for validators that sit behind sentries. To choose where to run a node use list_datacenter_providers.
name: get_celestia_decentralization
